column1: # Cormack Lab BG2 curated gene names, supplied by the Cunningham lab 2026-11-19.
# Source file: bg2_Annotation_forIGV.gff (CormackLab BG2 annotation, Assign=<CAGL id>/<name>).
# status: curated-name = a usable gene name. ambiguous-* = curators declined a 1:1 assignment.
#         bg2-frameshift / bg2-nonsense = BG2 sequence status, NOT a gene name.
